pages.text: Higher tier gold tools and gear. With the full set equipped, you can freely look at Endermen.$(br2)Syrum can be used to make $(l:sin_alignments/herbal_padlocks)Unbound Herbal Padlocks$() from $(l:sin_alignments/herbal_sigils)Herbal Sigils$().$(br2)Syrum can also be used to make an $(l:utilities/incense_provider)Incense Provider$() and a $(l:utilities/syrum_brush)Syrum Brush$(), which is necessary for traversing to the $(l:sin_alignments/arcane_ruins)Arcane Ruins$().
Can be made by putting Gold Ingots, Nuggets, or Blocks onto a Mystical Campfire.
